title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial
tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

exact_text.text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
exact_text.read_as:
FitTrack makes planning my workouts so
I finally have a routine that sticks.

faults.what: The visible captions leave the first sentence unfinished at “so”; “easy.” is not shown in any supplied frame, although it is present in the audio transcript. The displayed captions therefore do not establish an exact reproduction of the complete script.

judge.summary: The clip delivers a convincing casual home testimonial with a clearly fictional presenter, but the visible captions omit the end of the first sentence.

must_haves.item: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
must_haves.why: The clip is identified as eight seconds, the frames are vertical, and an adult woman films herself in a living room adjoining a kitchen; an on-screen disclosure identifies her as an AI presenter in a fictional dramatization.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcript matches the complete requested script exactly.

must_haves.item: Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
must_haves.why: The captions are large and readable, but the first sentence shown at one and three seconds ends with “so,” and the later frames display the second sentence without showing “easy.” Exact completeness is not demonstrated.

must_haves.item: The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
must_haves.why: Her mouth, expression, and hand gestures change across the frames in a manner consistent with speaking.

must_haves.item: The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.
must_haves.why: The visible label reads “AI presenter · Fictional dramatization,” with no real-customer or verified-customer claim.
